name: Blood Hawk
otherStatistics: Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A small bird of prey with crimson feathers, dark wing bars, and a sharply hooked beak.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, version 1.0, November 2018 , printed p. 120.
sections.Traits:
Keen Sight. The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Pack Tactics. The hawk has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Brown Bear
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A heavy brown bear with a pronounced shoulder hump, grizzled brown fur, and wide clawed paws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, version 1.0, November 2018 , printed p. 120.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Constrictor Snake
otherStatistics: Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages.
appearance: A broad-headed snake with heavy, muscular coils and dark brown markings on olive scales.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, version 1.0, November 2018 , printed p. 122.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapple it (escape DC 14). The target remains restrained until the grapple ends. While holding it, the snake cannot constrict another target.
